ORDER OF THE AGENDA

CONSENT CALENDAR

C-3.. CC - CONSENT ITEM:  Approval of the Updated Renewal of a Temporary Use Agreement with Lux Bus America Co. for the Temporary Use of a Shared Bus Stop by Apple's Commuter Shuttle.

C-4.. CC - CONSENT ITEM:  Award an In-Kind, Off-Cycle Special Events Grant in the Amount of $1,000 to Grid110 for a 2026 Holiday Marketplace Event and Designate the Event as City-Sponsored.

C-5.. CC - CONSENT ITEM: (1) Approval of a Pilot Program to Support Activations in Media Park and Direction to the City Manager as Deemed Appropriate; and (2) Authorize the City Manager to reduce or waive rental fees for the use of Media Park.

C-6.. CC - CONSENT ITEM: (1) Approval of the Culver City Arts District Business Improvement District Annual Work Plan and Budget; and (2) Adoption of a Resolution Declaring Intent to Levy the Culver City Arts District Business Improvement District Assessment for 2027 and Setting a Public Hearing on October 26, 2026.

C-1.. CC:HA:SA - CONSENT ITEM: Approval of Cash Disbursements for September 19, 2026 to October 2, 2026.

C-2.. CC:HA:SA:PA - CONSENT ITEM: Approval of Minutes of the Regular City Council Meeting Held on September 28, 2026.

PUBLIC HEARINGS AND ACTION ITEMS

PUBLIC HEARINGS

PH-1.. CC - PUBLIC HEARING: (1) Introduction of an Ordinance Confirming the Downtown Culver City Business Improvement District 2027 Annual Work Plan and Levy of Assessments; and (2) Appointment of Members to the Downtown Culver City Business Improvement District’s 2027 Advisory Board.  -  Action: opened (Pass) Moved by Albert Vera
